_purpose: Governance V2 adoption trust configuration. Identical to the canonical P2-B canary config on the /v2/decide surface (one A0 read-only observation; live mutation sealed) PLUS one authorize-side founder approver so /v2/authorize can verify FounderGrants and founder approvals. The founder secret is a placeholder the adoption launcher stamps from GOVERNANCE_FOUNDER_SECRET at start and refuses to launch without (scripts/governance-v2-adoption-runtime.sh). Adding this approver opens NOTHING on /v2/decide: the only admitted operation is A0 read_only (needs no approval) and the unratified mutation seal denies live mutation regardless of approvals.
_identity_contract: expected_source_shas pins the git source SHA the requesting component honestly attests. source_lineage is the qualification history behind that pin: when the Founder Runtime advances, the new SHA is qualified here and the old one marked superseded — the pin is then REQUIRED to move (a config still pinning a superseded SHA is refused at validation as STALE_SOURCE_PIN, and a request presenting a superseded SHA is denied SOURCE_SHA_SUPERSEDED with the superseding SHA named). Identity is never falsified and never silently stale.
